title: Identification of High-Risk Patients at Admission to an Emergency Department by Non-Invasive Hemodynamics
brief_summary: The goal of this study is to evaluate the prognostic values of non-invasive hemodynamic parameteres in relation to 30-day mortality and/or acute deterioration in patients who are admitted acutely to the department of emergency medicine or cardiology.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \> 18 years
* Admittance with acute illness at the department of medicine/emergency medicine / Cardiology at Bispebjerg Hospital
* Able to give informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Terminal disease like advanced cancer or advanced organ failure with a life expectancy of less then three months.
* Candidate for immediate intensive care therapy
* Refuse or unable to give consent
study_population: Population is patients admitted to the department of emergency medicin and/or cardiology department at Bispebjerg Hospital, Copenhagen, Denmark.
